name: University Intrigues
source:
Peter has just started a new life in a new city and at a new university. He has one goal: to find his first girlfriend! 

Of course, he isn’t a saint – and neither are the girls he’s about to meet. Or are they? He’ll have to find out for himself to discover who is truly the best girl for him.

[From [url=https://schurkin.itch.io/university-intrigues]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
彼得刚刚在一个新的城市和一所新的大学开始了新的生活。他的目标只有一个：找到他的第一个女朋友！

当然，他不是圣人——他即将遇到的女孩也不是。或者他们是吗？他必须亲自去发现谁才是真正最适合他的女孩​​。

[来自[url=https://schurkin.itch.io/university-intrigues]Itch.io[/url]]
